finalText:
Build is clean. The error was buried on line 17 of `src/core/settings.js` — it referenced an undefined variable `retries` instead of pulling it from the passed environment object.

Fixed it by adding `retries: 1` to the defaults and changing `maxRetries: retries` to `maxRetries: env.retries || DEFAULTS.retries`. Now it falls back to the default when not provided.

The build completes with the three warnings still there (deprecated-api, unused-export, circular-import), but those are just notes — no errors now.
